--- list basics
on t(l)
    return {(count l), length of l, item 1 of l, item -1 of l, rest of l, reverse of l, items 2 thru -1 of l, some item of l, l contains 1, l contains {1}, l & {9}, {0} & l, item 2 of l, class of l}
end t
--- list mutation
on t(l)
    set end of l to 1
    set beginning of l to 0
    set item 2 of l to "x"
    set item -1 of l to "z"
    set l to l & {5, 6}
    set l to rest of l
    set l to reverse of l
    set l to items 1 thru -2 of l
    return l
end t
--- list of lists
on t(m)
    set total to 0
    repeat with row in m
        repeat with cell in row
            set total to total + cell
        end repeat
    end repeat
    set item 2 of item 1 of m to 0
    return {total, item 1 of item 2 of m, (count item 1 of m), item 1 of item 1 of m}
end t
--- list filter by loop
on t(l)
    set out to {}
    repeat with x in l
        if contents of x > 2 then
            set end of out to contents of x
        end if
    end repeat
    return out
end t
--- list index of
on indexOf(l, v)
    repeat with i from 1 to (count l)
        if item i of l = v then
            return i
        end if
    end repeat
    return 0
end indexOf
--- list class filters
on t(l)
    return {every integer of l, every real of l, every string of l, every list of l, every record of l, every boolean of l, every number of l, every integer of l, integer 1 of l, string -1 of l, (count every integer of l), (count every integer of l)}
end t
--- record basics
on t(r)
    return {name of r, name of r, (count r), length of r, r & {extra:1}, {extra:1} & r, r as list, class of r, r contains {name:"a"}, r contains {name:"a"}}
end t
--- record mutation
on t(r)
    set name of r to "n"
    set size of r to 3
    set r to r & {added:true}
    set alpha of r to (alpha of r) + 1
    set end of items_ of r to 4
    set item 1 of items_ of r to 0
    return r
end t
--- record labels kinds
on t()
    return {name:"n", |name|:"u", size:1, |size|:2, id:3, |id|:4, class:"c", |class|:"d", alpha:5, |alpha beta|:6, x:7, |end|:8, |it|:9, result:10, |result|:11}
end t
--- nested records
on t(r)
    return {a of b of c of r, a of b of c of r, name of item 1 of rows of r, name of r & id of r, (count rows of r), a of item 1 of rows of r}
end t
--- record iteration by list
on t(rs)
    set names to {}
    repeat with r in rs
        set end of names to name of r & ":" & value of r
    end repeat
    return names
end t
--- booleans
on t(a, b)
    set x to true
    set y to false
    set z to a and not b
    if a then
        set x to not x
    end if
    if a = true then
        set y to true
    end if
    if b = false then
        set y to false
    end if
    return {x, y, z, a as integer, b as text, not a, a ≠ b, a = b}
end t
--- numbers
on t(n)
    return {n + 1, n - 1, n * 2, n / 2, n div 2, n mod 2, n ^ 2, -n, n as integer, n as real, (round n), n > 0, n ≥ 0, n = 0, n ≠ 0, (n + 0.5) div 1, n mod 1, n ^ 0.5}
end t
--- integer limits
on t()
    return {536870911, 5.36870912E+8, -536870911, -5.36870912E+8, -5.36870913E+8, 1.073741824E+9, 2.0E+9, 99999999, 100000000, 123456789}
end t
--- dates
on t()
    set d to current date
    set e to d + 1 * days
    set f to d - 2 * weeks
    set g to (e - d) div hours
    set day of d to 1
    set month of d to January
    set year of d to 2020
    set time of d to 12 * hours + 30 * minutes
    return {d, e, f, g, month of d, month of d as integer, weekday of d, d < e, date string of d, short date string of d, time string of d, d as text}
end t
--- date arithmetic
on t(d, e)
    return {d + 60, d - 3600, d + 2 * days, e - d, (e - d) / days, (e - d) div minutes, d > e, d = e, d ≥ e, month of d, weekday of d as integer, (year of d) - (year of e), (month of d) * 1}
end t
--- month and weekday tests
on t(d)
    if month of d = January then
        return 1
    end if
    if {Saturday, Sunday} contains weekday of d then
        return 2
    end if
    if month of d ≠ December and day of d > 15 then
        return 3
    end if
    return month of d as integer
end t
--- missing value handling
on t(x)
    if x = missing value then
        set x to "default"
    end if
    if x = missing value then
        return 1
    end if
    if x ≠ missing value and x ≠ "" then
        return 2
    end if
    set y to missing value
    return {x, y, y = missing value, class of y}
end t
--- class and coercion tests
on t(x)
    return {class of x, class of x = list, class of class of x, x as list, x as text, {x} as text, (x as list) & {1}, (count (x as list)), class of (x as text)}
end t
--- data and raw values
on t()
    return {«data utxt00480069», null, «class furl», «constant ****pict», «data TEXT68656C6C6F»}
end t
--- alias and file values
on t(p)
    set a to alias p
    set f to file p
    set g to POSIX file p
    set h to a as text
    set i to f as alias
    return {a, f, g, h, i, class of a, a as «class furl», POSIX path of a}
end t
--- constants
on t()
    return {yes, no, ask, true, false, missing value, null, current application, it, me, pi, space, tab, return, linefeed, quote, minutes, hours, days, weeks, AppleScript, version, version of AppleScript}
end t
--- units of measure
on t(x)
    return {x as miles, x as kilometers as number, x as pounds, x as grams, x as liters, x as degrees Celsius, x as degrees Kelvin, x as feet as inches as number, x as yards, x as ounces, x as quarts, x as cubic meters, x as square feet}
end t
--- big literal mix
on t()
    return {1, "a", 2.5, true, {2, "b", {3, "c", {4, "d"}}}, {k:1, l:{m:2, n:{o:3}}}, missing value, pi, {}, "", 0, -1, {{}}, {a:{}}}
end t
--- swapping and tuples
on t(a, b)
    set {a, b} to {b, a}
    set {x, y, z} to {1, 2, 3}
    set {p, {q, r}} to {a, {b, x}}
    set {name:n, id:i} to {name:"a", id:1}
    return {a, b, x, y, z, p, q, r, n, i}
end t
--- counting kinds
on t(l)
    return {(count l), (count l), (count every item of l), (count each item of l), (count every integer of l), number of every item of l, number of every string of l, (count every item of l), (count l) = 0, (count l) = 0, l = {}, l = {}}
end t
--- list equality and contains
on t(l)
    return {l = {1, 2}, l = {}, l ≠ {}, l contains 1, l contains {1, 2}, l starts with 1, l ends with {2}, l contains {1, 2}, not (l contains "a"), l contains {}}
end t
--- date literals
on t()
    return {date "Tuesday, February 3, 1970 at 12:00:00 AM", date "Tuesday, December 25, 2001 at 3:04:05 PM", date "Thursday, July 4, 1776 at 12:00:00 PM", date "Thursday, March 5, 2020 at 12:30:00 AM"}
end t
--- date literals of the Julian calendar
on t()
    return {date "Thursday, October 4, 1582 at 12:00:00 AM", date "Friday, October 15, 1582 at 12:00:00 AM", date "Monday, January 1, 1000 at 12:00:00 AM", date "Monday, June 15, 800 at 6:07:08 AM"}
end t
--- date in a property
property start : date "Tuesday, February 29, 2000 at 9:05:07 AM"

on t(d)
    return d > start
end t
